description: Figure 5 is a line plot that illustrates the proportion of SDPA output values below a threshold after gating, with two different thresholds represented on the x-axis: 1e-2 and 1e-3. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, which is a measure of the proportion of output values that are below the specified threshold. The plot includes three lines, each representing a different sparsity ratio: before gating (blue line), after gating (green line), and the average sparsity ratio (dotted line). The lines show how the sparsity ratio changes as the layer number increases. The plot also includes a legend that explains the color and style of each line.
